snippet.title: Bingo Betty - Gameplay Trailer 1
snippet.description:
This ain't your average grandma's bingo! Put your bingo skills to the test in this strategic roguelite spin on the classic game as you collect items, customize cards, create combos, cash in scratch tickets, and take betty to the top!

Try the free demo now, on steam!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4045170/Bingo_Betty/
